about: COP31 closing check-in (21 November 2026): the conference ran past its scheduled close. Terms are taken only from each report's own headline, because the pages could not be read from the build session; a claim reaches the page only if the source check finds them. Draft texts (including a reported adaptation finance figure dropped from a later draft) are not outcomes and are not staged. The negotiated decisions will be checked at a later check-in, once published.
